retention_tricks: Fast Cuts: Rapid scene changes every 1-2 seconds to maintain visual stimulation.
Text Overlays: Key points and captions appearing on screen, reinforcing audio and keeping attention.
Sound Design: Engaging background music, sound effects, and voice modulation to enhance impact.
Cliffhangers: Creating mini-suspense moments or implying a reveal to come in the next few seconds.
Visual Loops/Patterns: Repetitive or satisfying visual elements that are mesmerizing.
Anticipation Builds: Gradually revealing information or a visual, often with an increasing pace or sound.
